title: Introduce intake context-hash translator and epoched sampled-changelog generator
author: Maya Chen
body: Context and motivation: onboarding churn and noisy release notes made it hard for product teams to see meaningful change between model versions. This PR adds two complementary pieces: 1) an intake context-hash translator that canonicalizes variable metadata (dataset aliases, transient tags, environment fingerprints) into a stable context key used for grouping; 2) an epoched sampled-changelog generator that produces compact, representative change briefs per context-key over a configured epoch window, prioritizing performance-impacting changes and examples. Summary of changes: added a new translator module (registry/intake/context_hash.py) with deterministic hashing rules and small semantic normalization rules; introduced a changelog generator service (registry/changelog/epoch_sampler.py) which takes intake events, groups them by context-hash, samples representative diffs, scores them by signal (latency delta, accuracy regressor, footprint delta), and emits human-friendly brief snippets and machine-readable release fragments; wire-ups in the intake pipeline to compute and persist context_hash at the point of ingest; new DB migrations to store epoch markers and sample indices; unit and integration tests; docs for the release-tooling and a quickstart example. Design notes: context-hash aims to be stable across non-substantive metadata changes (e.g., dataset aliasing, timestamp noise) while still differentiating meaningful changes (schema change, quantization variant). The epoched sampler window is configurable (default 7 days) and uses reservoir sampling weighted by a change-impact score. Generated briefs include: title, short impact blurb, representative prompt/response diff, and linked model-version range. Rollout plan: feature gated via flags for 3 weeks, start in sampled mode for model-registry-staging then enable for small cohorts in production. Checklist: [x] deterministic hash algorithm with backward-compatible seed; [x] migration + migration tests; [x] sampling heuristics validated on historical runs; [x] CLI to preview generated briefs; [x] docs and quickstart. Commits: ["add context-hash translator and normalizer", "persist context-hash on intake write path", "epoched changelog sampler core loop and scoring", "db migration: epoch_markers and sample_index", "add CLI preview and docs", "add unit tests for hash stability and sampler"]. Changed files (high-level): ["registry/intake/context_hash.py", "registry/changelog/epoch_sampler.py", "api/ingest/handlers.py", "migrations/20250223_add_epoch_markers.sql", "tests/test_context_hash.py", "tests/test_epoch_sampler.py", "docs/onboarding/changelog_quickstart.md", "tools/changelog_preview.py"]. Review conversation highlights: "Owen: please document the hash collision strategy and provide a small tool to re-hash historical records" (reply: added collision doc and a rehash helper in tools/rehash.py); "Sofia: sampling bias toward large token-deltas looks high on small datasets" (reply: adjusted weighting to include a normalized sample_count term and added regression tests); "Dmitri: can we expose an API to request briefs for a given Linear ticket?" (reply: added a simple mapping endpoint and queued follow-up to expand filtering). CI: initial lint and unit CI failed on flake8 in epoch_sampler, fixed formatting; integration job showed a transient DB timeout on the first run, retried and passed. Performance testing: lightweight canary run on staging with 3-week historical fold shows generator runtime ~120ms per context group and additional memory footprint ~18MB; sampler respects batch window and parallelizes across context shards. Migration notes: migration is additive and non-blocking; older records without context_hash will be backfilled by a background job (tools/rehash.py) and the intake path emits a backfill marker to avoid double work. Release notes: ["Add context-hash translator for canonicalizing intake metadata to improve changelog grouping.", "Add epoched sampled changelog generator that produces concise, prioritized release briefs per context over configurable time windows.", "CLI and API preview for generated briefs.", "Non-blocking DB migrations and background rehash tooling."] How to test locally: follow docs/onboarding/changelog_quickstart.md to run a small ingest stream, run tools/changelog_preview.py --epoch 7 --sample 10 and review generated briefs. Follow-ups: expand scoring function to include qualitative eval signals, add retention controls for brief history, integrate brief previews into console release UI (tracked ENG-2190). Merge outcome: squash-merged to main after approvals and green CI.

release_notes: Add context-hash translator to canonicalize intake metadata for cleaner changelogs.
Add epoched sampled changelog generator to produce concise change briefs prioritized by impact.
Add CLI preview and lightweight API to fetch generated briefs.
Add non-blocking migrations and backfill tooling.
notes_for_oncall: Feature is behind a feature flag. Backfill job can be cancelled if it impacts DB load. If sampler spikes, reduce epoch window and scale sampler workers. See docs/onboarding/changelog_quickstart.md for mitigation steps.
